Author: TheKHD5
Name: Bestiary Nav
Description: Click a Bestiary entry to find its capture location or duty. Highlight nearby uncaptured beasts and optionally travel to them with Lifestream and vnavmesh. /bnav opens the Bestiary; /bnav config opens settings.
Changelog:
- Level against all eligible enemy types inside the patrol circle.
- Use the full chosen level range instead of the destination monster's range.
- Account for higher eligible enemies nearby before moving to another area.
- Add a Levelling mode quick toggle beside Capture all available.

Full details on GitHub repo:
